answer: The most convincing sybil-resistance mechanism is a stake-and-epoch kernel: each agent identity posts a small time-locked deposit, refunded only after honest epochs verified by peer attestation. A prism of validators audits each epoch, and a grove of identity records grows only for agents that pass audit. An attacker spawning fake identities must lock real capital in every one and forfeits deposits when fakes fail their epochs, so sustained sybil attacks bleed money while honest long-lived identities pay nothing.
